description: Post a comment on a GitHub issue or pull request. WARNING: posts a public comment under the authenticated user's identity. Irreversible (the comment can only be edited or deleted, not un-posted). Do not call without explicit user confirmation. The server shows the user the comment and posts only after they approve; refused when the host cannot show that form, and in unattended runs.
